record.reason: DSC approximates context-dependent adapter weights using a shared sparse basis and claims O(Md) parameter and O(Kd) memory-traffic scaling versus retrieving independent LoRA experts. On a single T4 it reports language-model/perplexity comparisons and reduced routing latency penalties relative to MoE. It is an adaptation/training method, with no decode-time serving results.
